thread:
Maya T.: Heads-up: Solstice Health POC kickoff next Tue. Procurement requires signed MSA+DPA + PO before provisioning. They also want Net45 on invoices and a VAT addendum for EU billing. Can we move fast?
Rafael P.: For the POC we recommended Dedicated-2 (1x A10G equiv) with burst to Dedicated-4 on peak. Asked for p95/p99 for 1k token shaders at 50 concurrent sessions. I can pull a short perf summary if infra confirms node counts.
Joan H.: They sent a security questionnaire (40 items) and asked for KMS HSM details and encryption-at-rest architecture. We can share SOC2 summary but full report needs NDA. Clarify whether they expect BYOK for POC.
Liam S.: Finance note: Net45 is unusual; standard is Net30. If they insist on Net45, need approval from Rev Ops for larger deals. Also need vendor tax form and a billing contact to map PO number. We can accept PO upstream but invoicing requires signed orderform.
Maya T.: Legal ask: customer redlined DPA to include 30-day deletion and unlimited audit rights. Also added SLA credit multiplier clause. Need legal language to push back.
LegalBot: Suggested DPA changes: limit audit to reasonable, pre-notified audits during business hours; deletion: certify deletion within 90 days and attest to backup purge within 180 days; liability cap aligned with fees paid in prior 12 months. Will draft counterproposal.
Rafael P.: On BYOK: for Hosted we don't offer BYOK, but for Private (VPC) we can support customer-managed keys via our onboarding with KMS tokens. For POC we can offer a scoped Private trial if legal/compliance sign-off. Performance numbers vary slightly for Private vs Hosted but I'll include both in the bench.
Joan H.: Uploaded SOC2 summary link: https://redwood.internal/compliance/soc2-snapshot.pdf. Also uploaded answers to network diagram Qs. Need KMS owner to confirm HSM vendor and key rotation policy.
Liam S.: If we accept Net45, we should push for shorter payment triggers on conversion to committed. Also propose milestone invoicing: initial setup fee due on PO acceptance, usage billed monthly Net30 afterwards. Will prepare invoice template.
Maya T.: Action list: @Rafael confirm perf CSV + node recommendations; @Joan confirm BYOK feasibility for POC and attach KMS notes; @LegalBot post DPA counter by EOD; @Liam prepare invoice template and note Net45 approval path. I'll ask the customer if they can accept Net30 to speed process.
FinanceBot: Created ticket INV-2026-4412 for Solstice Health PO workflow. Owner: Liam S.
Rafael P.: Quick perf estimate: Dedicated-2 p95 ~ 90ms token gen at 1k tokens; p99 depends on cache hit; with prefix cache enabled expect p99 < 400ms at 50 concurrent. I'll attach bench.csv to INV-2026-4412.
Joan H.: One blocker: they want SOC2 auditor contact. Legal suggests an NDA first. @Maya please request signed NDA so we can share full SOC2.
LegalBot: Draft NDA uploaded: https://redwood.internal/legal/templates/nondisclosure-onepager.docx. If they sign, we can share SOC2 report.
Maya T.: Thanks team. Goal: get countersigned MSA + DPA and PO by Friday to provision early next week. I'll update thread as we get signatures.
